title: Retire unused navigation UI and restore actual Frequency Drafts badge

source.ref: Actual server-resolved Drafts queue and zero runtime consumer audit

detail: Restore existing server-resolved myFrequency.drafts count to actual Frequency account and phone menu rows without new reads; badge hides zero/invalid values, caps display at99+, carries accessible exact count and remains member gated. Retire eight unused UI/model implementations. Keep shared analytics/readers, actual catalog permission reconciliation, Space app/order/scope tests, palette/route coverage and active Frequency replacements. Move historical viewport/event/visual mask probes to active consumers; preserve capture roster and canonical donation/telemetry constraints. Source/rendered/mock proof only; no deployment, production or browser acceptance claimed.
